# Filter log summary dates come from the message header

The filter-log-match-summary date argument comes from aMsgHdr->GetDate and is formatted in local time. Its Fluent comment says the time the filter was applied, which does not match the producer. The later log sink adds a separate current timestamp. Keep the message date and log timestamp distinct when documenting or reviewing this interface.

Scope: Filter logging variable contracts.
